My mother went to this clinic, and it was a complete scam. They saw she was a foreigner and dragged things out for eight months with no change. We didn't complain, but when we asked to see the original contract, they refused and showed us a new one without a signature. It's a clear scam. Terrible! When we tried to cancel, they said we had to pay 15,000 baht.

(Correction from the clinic's response):

When a customer asks to see the contract, we have the right to. The front desk staff should show it to the customer. It's not acceptable to shirk responsibility. We had to ask a third time before they genuinely provided it. This is a failure in the front desk's work. They should even apologize for the misunderstanding caused by the front desk service. Where else would a customer ask to see their signed contract and be given a blank one? No one does that! And we went three times!

The dental work was done eight months ago. I will post pictures to give a true review so other customers can decide for themselves whether it's improved or if they should continue. Eight months is a complete waste of time.

P.S. We're not complaining at all. Not even an apology, rude attitude, made me travel there three times, a complete waste of time, just to see the contract. If this continues, I might have to contact the Consumer Protection Agency for help, because this is the result of 8 months of treatment.
